missions.title: Patrol Route
missions.briefing: Hale, system patrol. The Bastion is the only patrol cutter out here, so the route is yours: {way_1}, then {way_2}, then {way_3}, in that order, each leg on the clock.

objectives.hint: Set a course for {way_1} ({way_1.distance} s). Out of time and a new route is drawn up.

missions.debrief: Route flown, on time, every leg. That's the standard. Now the real work.

missions.title: Traffic Check
missions.briefing: Routine inspection. The civilian freighter {freighter} is due a check of its manifest. Meet it, in orbit or on its course, and stay with it for thirty seconds while the boarding team does its work.

objectives.text: Stay with {freighter} until the inspection is done
objectives.hint: Same orbit, or flying to the same body: if it leaves, set a course for where it is heading.

missions.debrief: Manifest checks out: deuterium, ore and a crate of Andorian ale nobody declared. We let them off with a warning.

missions.title: Rogue Rock
missions.briefing: Hale. Tracking has a rock on a collision course with {target}, and there are people there. Catch {rock}, come alongside and lean on it with the tractor until it misses. Charges are quicker, if you trust your boarding party with them.

objectives.hint: It is moving: set course for it, then SCAN. The card counts down to impact.
COME ALONGSIDE, then PUSH IT ASIDE with the tractor (quicker with Engineering), or send an AWAY TEAM to plant charges.

missions.debrief: It will miss {target} by a comfortable margin now. Nobody down there will ever know how close it came, which is how Hale likes it.

missions.title: Distress Call
missions.briefing: Priority one: a distress beacon just lit up at {distress}. Get there before it is too late, then sweep the area for survivors.

objectives.text: Reach {distress} before the timer runs out
objectives.hint: Set a course for {distress} at once ({distress.distance} s).
Stay in orbit while the sensors sweep the area.

missions.debrief: We found them: a survey skiff with a dead reactor and six people in suits. All aboard, all alive.

missions.title: Escort
missions.briefing: There have been reports of trouble on the shipping lanes. Shadow the freighter {convoy}: be in orbit at its destination when it gets there.

objectives.text: Be at {convoy}'s destination when it arrives
objectives.hint: The system plot marks where {convoy} is heading next: get there first and wait.

missions.debrief: Freighter in safe and sound, and nothing on the lanes dared show itself with the Bastion waiting.

missions.title: The Smuggler's Belt
missions.briefing: Hale. A freighter went dark in the belt and hasn't come out: transponder off, hiding among the rocks. Long-range scans from different rocks near her will give fixes, and three good fixes find her. Then go alongside and inspect her. She may run once she knows she's spotted.

objectives.text: Take three fixes on her from different rocks and find her
objectives.hint: Fly to a marked rock, run a LONG-RANGE SCAN, then move to another rock and scan again: each fix shrinks the search area.
Set course for her (if she runs, follow) and SCAN her.
COME ALONGSIDE once she has stopped.
INSPECT HER: the boarding party goes through her holds.

missions.debrief: Undeclared weapons parts and a hold full of Orion spice. Her master paid the fine without a word, which tells Hale there's more out there.

missions.title: Picket
missions.briefing: Last duty of the watch: picket at {edge}, the outermost body. Hold orbit there for two minutes and keep the long-range scanners busy.

objectives.hint: Set a course for {edge} ({edge.distance} s) and stay there.
SCAN whenever the scanners have recharged.

missions.debrief: Picket stood down. Quiet watch, the way we like them. Hale out: that's the chapter, Bastion.
